name: Summer at AIM
description_short: Four week summer program at AIM Academy in Conshohocken for students in grades 1 to 12 from any school. AIM teachers give small group instruction in reading, writing, comprehension and math with interactive projects, full day or mornings only.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund for withdrawal before May 1; after May 1 a full refund is not possible.
special_needs_notes: Built on AIM's approach to language based learning differences, but no diagnosis is required. AIM says the program cannot serve cognitive impairment, needs on the autism spectrum, or emotional or behavioral conduct disorders. Non AIM students have a short virtual academic screening.

sessions.name: Summer at AIM, full day (9 am to 4 pm)
Summer at AIM, mornings only (9 am to 12:30 pm)

notes: 2027: July 6 to July 30 (closed July 5). The page presents these as early bird rates: full day $3,800, mornings $2,800, before care $260, after care $260 for the program. 50% deposit before May 1, balance due May 1; no proration for missed days. No summer scholarships. Bring lunch and snacks. Van service from Center City was offered in past years through a private company; the campus is across from SEPTA's Miquon station.
